Why choose a Doctorate in Astrophysics
The most advanced areas of astrophysics research, research groups and the best international instruments in various bands such as optical, millimetre, radio, X-ray and ultra-high energy: this is the focus of the study and research offered by the Doctorate in Astrophysics.
